_comment: Client testimonials copied from danmckennahomes.com (Nov 2026). 'excerptOnly: true' means the live site only showed a cut-off excerpt; we keep only the complete sentences until Dan supplies the full text. Never write or edit a client's words.

items.title: Accessible every step of the way
text: Dan is the man. Incredibly knowledgeable and so easy to work with. Dan won’t let you make the wrong decision.

items.title: An Agent you want to work with
text: Dan is the real estate agent who consistently puts his clients first.

items.title: First Time Home Buyer
text: From start to finish, Dan went above and beyond, ensuring the process was smooth and stress-free.

items.title: Sold a single family home in Waxhaw
text: Dan McKenna sold our home in just 1 month! This full time Realtor did everything you could hope for as an agent for us. He was referred to us by friends, and we are glad we chose Dan! We got a great price for our home and had multiple offers to consider.

items.title: Referred my friends and my family to Dan
text: I highly recommend Dan McKenna. He is one of the most professional people you will ever meet in the business. He is honest and knowledgeable and a fierce advocate for his clients. Not only has Dan represented several of my friends but he is currently helping my parents purchase a house in Indian Land. I would put my utmost trust in Dan McKenna for any real estate matter.

items.title: Built a new home in Waxhaw
text: Best realtor EVER!!!!!!!! He made our transition smooth and easy!!!

items.title: Looking to relocate to Waxhaw
text: When we were looking to relocate from New York, Dan and Wendy went out of their way for us. Dan took us around and showed us different neighborhoods and different complexes with different builders. Answered any questions we had. Very knowledgeable, friendly and patient. Wendy is a sweetheart and will answer any questions you may have and even help talk you though any concerns or fears you may have. Highly recommend them.

items.title: Purchased a home in Waxhaw
text: I recommend Dan Mckenna with the highest level possible. Dan's knowledge of the market is 100% on point. Dan knows and understands the Carolinas. He walked me through one of the toughest deals I ever made. He acted as if it was his own home purchase. Simply Amazing !!! He is extremely professional and I recommend him highly. I look forward to doing business with Dan again.

items.title: Sold a home and purchased a home in Waxhaw
text: If you are looking to put your home on the market Dan McKenna with Keller Williams Realty is awesome! He takes charge from the start. From staging to the final closing he was so helpful. He spent a great deal of time helping us determine the maximum value while getting our house sold in 1 day. And he didn't stop there. He even helped me in moving some of my heavier items. Above & beyond. Hopefully we don't have to move for a long time, but Dan will be our realtor when we do.

items.title: Relocated from New York
text: I am writing to express my most sincere thanks and appreciation to Dan McKenna for helping us find our beautiful home. Dan was highly recommended by a friend. Moving our entire family across the country was a very scary thing but I must say Dan made the home buying process very easy for us. He was very understanding, patient, knowledgeable and very professional. He took the time to get to know us and our family needs. He found us exactly what we were looking for. Dan also didn't forget us once the deal was done. We called Dan for recommendations for a handyman, great restaurants and other professional needs. He has always come through with excellence. We were very pleased with his services and guidance. It's been a pleasure working with you, and will highly recommend you to family and friends looking to buy or sell a home.

items.title: Downsized my home
text: Our family relocated a little over a year ago from a near by neighborhood to The Chimneys and met Dan and his wife, Wendy, at an Open House. I immediately felt very comfortable with them after asking preliminary questions about possibly moving. They were not pushy, by any means, in trying to obtain our listing and answered all of my questions even though I was not interested in the home they were showing which was why we decided to partner up. Dan was readily available whenever we needed him and helped to make our stressful experience much easier. Our home sold in 2 days but we then had to deal with some extremely difficult and picky buyers. Dan advocated for us in many situations so we were not taken advantage of on either end of the transactions and we feel that we can call both of them our friends!!!

items.title: Found a home for my mother-in-Law
text: I am writing to highly recommend realtor Dan McKenna. I reached out to Dan to assist in finding a home for my mother-in-law. She is very new to the area, had very specific needs in regards to budget, timing of move and needed to be in close proximity to our family. Dan took the time, listened and understood exactly what she wanted and would not compromise in finding the best place. He made the right recommendations and negotiated the right price. My mother-in-law was very comfortable working with Dan, loves her new home and is less than an 8 minute drive from us. Dan is very knowledgeable about the area and the markets and is very genuine and trustworthy. Please contact him if you do need a realtor, you will be very happy you did. Dan McKenna, http://www.DanMcKennaHomes.com, office is 704-441-4556

items.title: Looking to relocate to Charlotte Area
text: Dan is very professional and very patient. I've been indecisive about moving from NY and buying in NC. He knows the areas very well and is very informative. I would definitely recommend Dan for all of your real estate needs.
